description: This file defines types and implementations related to managing user notifications in an iOS application using the UserNotifications framework. It includes an enum for notification authorization statuses, a protocol for notification center operations, and a concrete implementation of that protocol.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the NotificationCentering protocol that wraps around UNUserNotificationCenter, providing async methods for notification management.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification authorization with specified options, asynchronously.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a notification request asynchronously, handling errors accordingly.
